s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive headache and neurological deficits due to an extra-axial brain mass
salient_findings: Large extra-axial heterogeneous mass on brain imaging
key_facts: 19-year-old man
No significant medical history
2-week history of progressive headache
Two episodes of vomiting
12-month history of apathy and declining academic performance
Right pronator drift on neurologic examination
Normal remainder of neurologic examination
Large extra-axial heterogeneous mass on noncontrast CT and contrast-enhanced MRI
Erosion of the inner table of the left frontal bone
Near-complete erosion of the outer table of the left frontal bone
Evidence of calvarial destruction and a small extracranial component

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive headache and neurological deficits due to an extra-axial brain mass
salient_findings: Large extra-axial heterogeneous mass on brain imaging
key_facts: 19-year-old man
No significant medical history
2-week history of progressive headache
Two episodes of vomiting
12-month history of apathy and declining academic performance
Right pronator drift on neurologic examination
Normal remainder of neurologic examination
Large extra-axial heterogeneous mass on noncontrast CT and contrast-enhanced MRI
Erosion of the inner table of the left frontal bone
Near-complete erosion of the outer table of the left frontal bone
Evidence of calvarial destruction and a small extracranial component

shortlist.label: Hemangiopericytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Entertained as a diagnosis based on imaging findings of a large extra-axial heterogeneous mass with erosion of the inner table of the left frontal bone and near-complete erosion of the outer table

shortlist.label: Meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Common extra-axial brain tumor that can present with similar imaging characteristics

shortlist.label: Dural metastasis
shortlist.why_kept: Possible consideration given the presence of a large extra-axial mass with calvarial destruction and a small extracranial component

shortlist.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Can present as a dural-based mass with similar imaging characteristics

shortlist.label: Sarcomatoid meningioma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive variant of meningioma that can present with bone erosion and extracranial extension

raw.rationale: The large extra-axial heterogeneous mass with well-defined lobulated margins, avid enhancement of denser areas, and evidence of calvarial destruction are consistent with hemangiopericytoma, which is a rare tumor that can cause bone erosion and has a variable appearance on imaging

rejected.label: Meningioma
rejected.why: While meningiomas can be extra-axial and cause bone erosion, the presence of a large heterogeneous mass with susceptibility artifacts consistent with calcification and/or hemorrhage is less typical for meningioma

rejected.label: Dural metastasis
rejected.why: Dural metastases are typically multiple and less likely to cause significant bone erosion, and the clinical history does not suggest a known primary malignancy

rejected.label: Solitary fibrous tumor
rejected.why: Solitary fibrous tumors are typically well-circumscribed and less likely to cause significant bone erosion, and the imaging appearance is not as heterogeneous as described in this case

rejected.label: Sarcomatoid meningioma
rejected.why: Sarcomatoid meningiomas are rare and aggressive variants of meningioma, but the imaging appearance and clinical history in this case are more suggestive of hemangiopericytoma
